summary: The original wizard-wish corpse-stack stop is fixed by wiring makewish’s canonical isReviver hook. Continued replay exposed two bounded source-path defects, also fixed here: do.js preflight now admits the timed corpse pile merge allowed by invent.c:mergable, and pray.js imports canonical align_str for eval_offering’s unicorn branch. After these fixes the admitted v43 replay matches through step 290 (291 screens, cursors, and RNG prefix); its first remaining divergence at step 291 is the separate pray.c:give_spell spellbook-generation path, which is intentionally outside this delivery.

source.branch: In zap.c:makewish, when a wizard wish creates a CORPSE and hold_another_object adds it to inventory, invent.c:mergable reaches its corpse branch after candidate objects have matching corpsenm values; for corpsenm >= LOW_PM it calls is_reviver(&mons[otmp->corpsenm]) and refuses to merge if true. JavaScript reaches the same branch in js/invent.js:mergable, which requires hooks.isReviver. The makewish-specific holdEnv omits the adapter already supplied by objectGenerationEnv, producing the step-100 UnsupportedObjectOperationError instead of C’s predicate result.
callers: cmd.c:rhack dispatches C(w) through wizcmds.c:wiz_wish to zap.c:makewish; JavaScript follows js/cmd.js:runWishCommand -> js/wizcmds.js:wiz_wish -> js/zap.js:makewish.

zap.c:makewish passes its inventory/drop callbacks to hold_another_object, which reaches do.c:dropx when the wished object is dropped; js/zap.js:makewish supplies dropObject: js/do.js:dropx, whose preflight_dropx previously rejected a timed corpse merge admitted by invent.c:mergable.
pray.c:dosacrifice -> offer_corpse -> eval_offering; JavaScript js/pray.js:dosacrifice -> offer_corpse -> eval_offering.
dependencies: js/object_generation.js:objectGenerationEnv already provides the canonical hooks.isReviver adapter

additionalUnits.correction: Preflight admits a timed corpse pile member only when both objects are corpses with matching species and the member is neither lamplit nor globby, preserving the downstream merged() timer stop.
Added the canonical align_str import used by the source branch when a unicorn is offered on an altar aligned with the hero; the source function logic was already ported.
